sloka: रावणान्तःपुरे रोधं राक्षसीभिश्च तर्जनम् ।रामे समनुरागं च यश्चायं समयः कृतः ।एतदाख्यान्ति ते सर्वे हरयो रामसन्निधौ ।। ५.६५.३ ।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇāntaḥpure rodhaṁ rākṣasībhiśca tarjanam ।rāme samanurāgaṁ ca yaścāyaṁ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ ।etadākhyānti te sarve harayo rāmasannidhau ।। 5.65.3 ।।।।

translations.english: The monkeys in Rama's presence narrated all about Sita's detention in Ravana's Ashoka garden, the ogresses threatening her and the time limit fixed by Ravana (for her survival).
